verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents on-demand deployments that run on dedicated GPUs with "predictable performance unaffected by other users" and no hard rate limits, which isolates traffic from the shared serverless pool. Autoscaling is documented in detail: replica counts, scale-up/down windows, load targets and scale-to-zero, all set via firectl flags. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the dedicated-deployment isolation and autoscaling behavior.
